build_lake_project: run lake build on a Lean worktree directory with semaphore concurrency control
build_lake_async: run lake build asynchronously on a worktree with non-blocking concurrency control
configure_max_concurrent_builds: set the maximum number of concurrent lake build processes allowed
get_build_stats: get current build concurrency stats including active builds and available slots
review_build_result: review a BuildResult dataclass to check success, error, duration, and timeout status
